scope: Qlib complete-month decision calendar, source readiness, and time-alignment interface; no valuation feature calculation, labels, fit, inference, accounts or promotion.

Do not declare source_ready from positive row count and nonnull path alone; independently accepted qualified source and real hashed input are required.

Latest economic observation, then latest available release at cutoff; preserve historic decision vintages.
60-month history,36 distinct same-method prior observations,45-day maximum age and95percent known earnings coverage.
Negative earnings remain signed; unknown earnings weight explicitly retained.
limitations: Synthetic interface tests do not qualify real source history.
